Emails often include realistic links to fake login pages. Users act without verification. Scammers harvest credentials or financial information. This tactic leverages anxiety and urgency.
random.IMPACT_PARAGRAPH_1: It matters because fear triggers impulsive compliance.
random.IMPACT_PARAGRAPH_2: It also highlights why verification processes are critical.
random.DID_YOU_KNOW: Payment scare phishing emails have among the highest click rates.
